title: Butcher knife

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Butcher knife is a utility knife. It has no secondary attack.
Its singular usage is to kill tamed animals without having to enable Friendly fire. The knife can only hurt tamed creatures, and is the only item currently able to do so.

Introduction. The Butcher knife is a utility knife. It has no secondary attack.
Its singular usage is to kill tamed animals without having to enable Friendly fire. The knife can only hurt tamed creatures, and is the only item currently able to do so.
